Likud, Yashar, B’Yachad agree to continue coalition talks

en.title: Likud Yashar B’Yachad agree to continue coalition talks
en.dek: Likud, Yashar, and B’Yachad stated they would continue coalition talks according to JNS.org.
facts: Likud, Yashar, and B’Yachad agreed to continue coalition talks on 15 November 2026.
JNS.org reported this agreement on 15 November 2026.
body: JNS.org reported that Likud, Yashar, and B’Yachad agreed to continue coalition talks.
en.context: The provided sources detail political agreements in Israel and a state of siege in Guatemala; no background information explaining the Israeli coalition talks is present in the texts.
en.imageCaption: Policial morto em ataque armado que também matou outros dois agentes e o deputado Julio César Portillo Paz, em Zacapa -

de.title: Likud, Yashar und B’Yachad einigen sich auf Fortsetzung der Koalitionsgespräche
de.dek: Likud, Yashar und B’Yachad gaben laut JNS.org bekannt, die Koalitionsgespräche fortzusetzen.
facts: Likud, Yashar und B’Yachad einigten sich am 15. November 2026 auf Fortsetzung der Koalitionsgespräche
JNS.org berichtete über diese Einigung am 15. November 2026.
body: JNS.org berichtete, dass Likud, Yashar und B’Yachad sich auf die Fortsetzung der Koalitionsgespräche geeinigt haben.
de.imageCaption: Polizist getötet bei bewaffnetem Angriff, bei dem auch zwei weitere Beamte und der Abgeordnete Julio César Portillo Paz in Zacapa ums Leben kamen

fr.title: Likoud, Yashar et B’Yachad s'accordent pour poursuivre les pourparlers de coalition
fr.dek: Likoud, Yashar et B’Yachad ont déclaré qu'ils poursuivraient les pourparlers de coalition, selon JNS.org.
facts: Likoud, Yashar et B’Yachad ont convenu de poursuivre les pourparlers de coalition le 15 novembre 2026
JNS.org a rapporté cet accord le 15 novembre 2026
body: JNS.org a rapporté que Likoud, Yashar et B’Yachad ont convenu de poursuivre les pourparlers de coalition.
L'accord a été conclu le 15 novembre 2026.
fr.imageCaption: Policier mort lors d'une attaque armée qui a également tué deux autres agents et le député Julio César Portillo Paz, à Zacapa

es.title: Likud, Yashar y B'Yachad acuerdan continuar las conversaciones de coalición
es.dek: Likud, Yashar y B'Yachad declararon que seguirán las conversaciones de coalición según JNS.org.
facts: Likud, Yashar y B'Yachad acordaron continuar las conversaciones de coalición el 15 de noviembre de 2026
JNS.org informó de este acuerdo el 15 de noviembre de 2026
body: JNS.org informó que Likud, Yashar y B’Yachad acordaron continuar las conversaciones de coalición.
El acuerdo se produjo el 15 de noviembre de 2026.
es.imageCaption: Policía muerto en ataque armado que también mató a otros dos agentes y al diputado Julio César Portillo Paz, en Zacapa

it.title: Likud, Yashar e B’Yachad concordano di proseguire i colloqui di coalizione
it.dek: Likud, Yashar e B’Yachad hanno dichiarato che continueranno i colloqui di coalizione secondo JNS.org.
facts: Likud, Yashar e B’Yachad hanno concordato di continuare i colloqui di coalizione il 15 novembre 2026
JNS.org ha riportato questo accordo il 15 novembre 2026
body: JNS.org ha riportato che Likud, Yashar e B’Yachad hanno concordato di proseguire i colloqui di coalizione.
L'accordo è stato raggiunto il 15 novembre 2026.

pt.title: Likud, Yashar e B'Yachad concordam em continuar as negociações de coligação
pt.dek: Likud, Yashar e B'Yachad declararam que prosseguiriam com as negociações de coligação, segundo JNS.org.
facts: Likud, Yashar e B'Yachad acordaram continuar as negociações de coligação a 15 de novembro de 2026

zh.title: 希路德、雅希尔和巴亚哈德同意继续组阁谈判
zh.dek: 希路德、雅希尔和巴亚哈德声明将继续组阁谈判，据 JNS.org 报道。
facts: 希路德、雅希尔和巴亚哈德同意继续组阁谈判
JNS.org 在 2026 年 11 月 15 日报告了这一协议
body: JNS.org报道，利库德、雅沙尔和巴亚哈德同意继续组阁谈判。

ja.title: リクド、ヤシャル、バヤハドは連立交渉の継続に合意
ja.dek: リクド、ヤシャル、バヤハドは連立交渉を継続すると発表した（JNS.org）。
facts: リクド、ヤシャル、バヤハドは2026年11月15日に連立交渉の継続に合意した
JNS.orgは2026年11月15日にこの合意を報じた
body: リクド、ヤシャル、バヤハドは連立交渉の継続に合意した。JNS.orgが報じた。
合意は2026年11月15日に行われた。
ja.context: 提供された情報源には、イスラエルでの政治的合意とグアテマラでの戒厳令に関する記述はあるが、イスラエルの連立交渉に関する背景情報は含まれていない。

ko.title: 리쿠드, 야샤르, 바야카드 연정 협상 지속 합의

body: 리쿠드, 야샤르, 바야카드 정당은 연정 협상을 지속하기로 합의했다.
ko.context: 제공된 출처에는 이스라엘의 정치적 합의와 과테말라의 계엄령에 대한 세부 사항이 포함되어 있으며, 이스라엘 연정 협상에 대한 배경 정보는 텍스트에 제시되어 있지 않다.

problemsFixed: The draft mixes information from two unrelated sources (Guatemala and Israel) without clear separation, violating the principle that every sentence must add unique information and maintain focus.

The draft contains repetitive sentences and ends paragraphs with evaluative or summary statements (e.g., 'No other political agreements were reported in the provided sources,' 'No further details regarding the substance of the talks were provided in the source material').
The structure does not adhere to PLAIN rhythm requirements (varying sentence length, avoiding four short declarative sentences in a row).
The body includes a sentence referencing the Guatemalan situation, which breaks the focus on the Israeli talks, and vice versa.
